boundaries.contract: Rank-0 scatter/select/gather rejects any axis. ND can produce scalar output from rank>=1 data.
boundaries.name: rank_zero_axis

boundaries.contract: Rank 8 uses singleton padding. Rank 9 rejects before dispatch.
boundaries.name: rank_limit

boundaries.contract: N=2^31-1 remains symbolic. N=2^31 rejects. No large allocation.
boundaries.name: count_limit
rejections: 2*N outside U32 after checked U64 size calculation

boundaries.contract: Checked U32 pair arithmetic, unsigned U32->U64 extension before signed I64 TilePtr offset, actual IR acceptance, and masked-lane sanitation.
boundaries.name: wide_physical_extent

forbidden: Sign-extend U32 physical offset through I32
Double unsanitized invalid or inactive logical coordinates
Wrap U32 intermediate arithmetic then rely on the final memory mask
Truncate U64/I64 pointer offset back to I32
ir_acceptance: Actual generated IR must show unsigned U32->U64 extension, or a demonstrably equivalent 64-bit zero extension.
A signed offset consumer receives I64 with upper 32 bits zero for high-U32 physical offsets.
No signed I32 extension occurs on physical offsets >=0x80000000.
Word-offset to byte-address scaling uses 64-bit arithmetic and preserves the positive offsets in the fixtures.
The masked-coordinate selection dominates doubling, high-word addition, zero extension, pointer construction, and memory use.
Both low and high pointer construction sites satisfy these checks for values and destination; a host extent receipt is insufficient.
sequence: Validate logical extent N in [1, i32::MAX] before element work; N=0 uses the validated empty shortcut.
Validate physical words=checked_U64(2*N), require <=u32::MAX, then exact U32 conversion.
Mask tile positions before signed conversion or any stride/scale arithmetic. Replace inactive coordinates and invalid logical j with zero.
Validate signed view spans with I128 host arithmetic; evaluate signed address components in I64, then require 0<=j<N.
Select safe_j=valid?exact_U32(j):0. Prove safe_j<=N-1<=0x7ffffffe before checked U32 doubling.
Compute low=checked_U32(2*safe_j), high=checked_U32(low+1); both are <physical_words for nonempty tensors.
Unsigned zero-extend each U32 physical word index to U64 before any signed pointer-offset conversion.
Reinterpret or exactly convert that U64 to I64 only after proving <=0xffffffff. The resulting signed offset is nonnegative.
Pass Tile<I64> word offsets to a *mut/*const U32 pointer offset operation. Pointee scaling by four stays in 64-bit arithmetic.
Mask every load/store/atomic independently; masked lanes still use safe, non-overflowing coordinates and pointer offsets.
physical_pointer_conversion.target_acceptance: Frontend declarations are insufficient. A later authorized probe must inspect actual Tile IR and target-address lowering. No compiler was invoked.

boundaries.contract: Signed values <0 reject. Index payloads do not inherit negative dimension wrapping.
boundaries.name: signed_index_low

boundaries.contract: I64/U64 2^32+1 cannot become coordinate 1 after narrowing.
boundaries.name: wide_index_alias

boundaries.contract: For axis length L, L-1 is valid and L is invalid. L=0 permits no update.
boundaries.name: upper_coordinate

boundaries.contract: Do not cast i32::MAX or L into I8/U8 before comparison.
boundaries.name: narrow_bound_scalar

boundaries.contract: Tuple [1,-1] rejects before linearization and cannot alias a preceding row.
boundaries.name: ND_coordinate_validation

boundaries.contract: Checked shape products and per-axis bounds precede I32 linearization.
boundaries.name: ND_linear_overflow

boundaries.contract: Empty scatter/select updates preserve destination after dtype/shape validation. Nonempty updates to L=0 reject.
boundaries.name: empty_axis_updates

boundaries.contract: M=0, K=0 or zero index elements reject under pinned public checks and Native nd_shape.
boundaries.name: ND_empty_indices

boundaries.contract: Nonempty valid index shape with zero trailing slice yields empty payload. Current Native skips coordinate reads.
boundaries.name: empty_ND_trailing_slice

boundaries.contract: i32::MIN/MAX strides are symbolic. Use I128 host span arithmetic and reject any nonempty out-of-storage span.
boundaries.name: signed_view_span

boundaries.contract: Odd half offset and final half share words. Unselected fields and unused tail bits remain unchanged.
boundaries.name: packed_neighbor

boundaries.contract: I64/U64/F64 high and low words belong to one logical owner. No independent-word atomic arithmetic.
boundaries.name: wide_word_pair

boundaries.contract: Max([-8,-7],base=-9)=-7. Zero is an invalid identity for this fold.
boundaries.name: all_negative_extrema

boundaries.contract: Empty contribution set returns the base. Min/Max do not initialize destinations to zero or infinity.
boundaries.name: base_inclusion

boundaries.contract: Equal finite values stay equal. Min(+0,-0), Max(+0,-0), Add(-0,-0), and Mul(-0,+1) require bit checks.
boundaries.name: float_ties_and_zeros

boundaries.contract: Exercise NaN on either side, both NaN, and NaN followed by finite. Payload policy and Linux lowering remain open.
boundaries.name: NaN_classes

boundaries.contract: Inf+(-Inf), 0*Inf, overflow, smallest subnormal, and half RNE midpoints need explicit arithmetic policy.
boundaries.name: infinity_and_underflow

boundaries.contract: [2^(p),1,-2^(p)] distinguishes per-update storage rounding from one final rounding. No invented tolerance.
boundaries.name: nonassociative_duplicates

boundaries.contract: Pinned unique-index Min/Max backward sends full gradient to both equal inputs. Duplicate gradients remain undefined.
boundaries.name: minmax_gradient_tie

boundaries.contract: One semantic failure must not poison a later independent valid graph. Retired temporaries live through queued completion.
boundaries.name: error_and_lifetime

empty_rule: max(width.words(N),1) unused words for logical allocation. N=0 owns one unused word at every dtype and dispatches no element work; never width.words(max(N,1)).
